workflow.name: Send staged Companies House filing reminders with Gmail, Slack and Sheets
workflow.description:
## Quick overview
This workflow runs daily to monitor a UK company watchlist via the Companies House Public Data API, sending staged deadline reminders, overdue repeats, filing confirmations, and status-change alerts to Gmail, Slack, or SMTP, and optionally appending an audit log to Google Sheets.

## How it works
1. Runs daily at 08:00 (Europe/London) or on manual trigger and parses the watchlist and reminder settings.
2. Looks up each company in the Companies House API and handles common API errors (for example 401, 404, and rate limiting).
3. When a due date moves forward since the previous run, fetches recent filing history from Companies House to include as evidence.
4. Calculates accounts and confirmation statement reminder stages (for example 30/14/7/1 days), weekly overdue repeats, filing-confirmed events, and strike-off/liquidation or other status changes, while deduplicating notifications using stored state.
5. If there is anything new to report (or an optional weekly digest), routes the message to the enabled channels (Gmail, Slack, or SMTP) and formats the content as text or HTML.
6. If Google Sheets logging is enabled, appends one audit-log row per event (or per company for a digest/baseline) to a “Filings” sheet.

## Setup
1. Create a free Companies House REST API key and add it as an HTTP Basic Auth credential (API key as username, blank password) for the Companies House API requests.
2. Populate the Settings watchlist with company numbers (optionally including a label and per-company warning window) and adjust reminderDays, overdueRepeatDays, and notifyChannels as needed.
3. Enable and configure at least one notification channel (Gmail, Slack, or SMTP) by adding credentials and setting the recipient email address or Slack channel.
4. To log to Google Sheets, enable the Google Sheets node, connect your Google account, and set the target spreadsheet URL/ID and ensure a “Filings” tab exists.
5. (Optional) Enable the error-alert Gmail or Slack node and set this workflow as its own Error workflow in n8n workflow settings to receive failure notifications.

workflow.name: UK Companies House filing reminders: staged deadline alerts, filing confirmation and status changes

parameters.content:
## Remind clients before Companies House deadlines

For accountants, bookkeepers and company directors. Watches UK companies on the official Companies House API and sends one reminder per stage (for example 30, 14, 7 and 1 days) before accounts or a confirmation statement are due. It repeats overdue alerts weekly, confirms when a filing is made and flags strike-off or liquidation. A ledger stops repeat messages.

### How it works
1. **Daily schedule** (08:00 UK) or **Test manually** reads **Settings** and your watchlist.
2. Each company is fetched from `GET /company/{number}` with retries and a pause.
3. If a due date has moved on since the last run, **Get recent filings** fetches the filing history as evidence.
4. **Apply reminder ladder** works out which events are new, using workflow static data, and builds the message and Sheets rows.
5. Only new events are sent, to the channels in `notifyChannels`.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Get a free **REST** API key at [developer.company-information.service.gov.uk](https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk).
- [ ] Add one HTTP Basic Auth credential (username = API key, password blank) to **Get company profile** and **Get recent filings**.
- [ ] In **Settings**, list companies in `watchlist`, one per line: `number | label | warnDays` (label and days optional).
- [ ] Set `notifyChannels`, then enable those output nodes, add credentials and enter your recipient address or Slack channel (left blank on purpose).
- [ ] Run **Test manually**, check the output, then activate.

### Customise
Change `reminderDays`, `defaultWarnDays` or `overdueRepeatDays`. Turn on `sendWeeklyDigest` for a full status table every `digestWeekday`.

Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (Companies House). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Companies House.

### Before you activate
- Without a valid REST key the API returns 401 and the run stops with a clear error.
- The first active run saves a baseline. With `notifyOnFirstRun` on, it also sends anything already overdue or inside its warning window.
- The reminder ledger lives in workflow static data, which n8n saves only for **active** runs. Manual tests can repeat reminders.
- Company-level data only: no officer, director or PSC names.
- Each company costs one API call (two when a filing is detected). The limit is 600 calls per 5 minutes.
- For failure alerts, set **Workflow settings > Error workflow** to this workflow.

## 1. Trigger, settings and watchlist
Runs daily at 08:00 UK or on demand. Validates **Settings** and turns the watchlist into one item per company, each with its own warning window.

## 2. Fetch each company and check for new filings
Calls the official API with a pause between companies. When a due date has moved on since the last run, it also fetches recent filings as evidence.

## 3. Apply the reminder ladder and decide
Works out which reminders, overdue alerts, filings and status changes are new since the last run. Stops when there is nothing new.

## 4. Send to your channels
Sends only to the channels in `notifyChannels`. Google Sheets gets one audit-log row per event in a tab called `Filings`.

## Error alerts
Runs when the workflow fails, once it is set as its own Error workflow. Enable the Gmail or Slack node you use, add your credentials and recipient.

The IF node can be used to implement binary conditional logic in your workflow. You can set up one-to-many conditions to evaluate each item of data being inputted into the node. That data will either evaluate to TRUE or FALSE and route out of the node accordingly.

This node has multiple types of conditions: Bool, String, Number, and Date & Time.
